body: RULING / ORACLE CORRECTION: reject only Unreachable for a readable source. My earlier phrase including custom Unassessable was overbroad and is withdrawn. Current LAW 3 establishes a lawful readable-source Unassessable result for zero-support DefaultLocalCostModel cells while inference succeeds and preserves the audit rows. At the LocalCostModel boundary an identical Unassessable returned by a custom model has no published field that distinguishes it from that lawful value; rejecting one but not the other would require inventing producer identity or authority. Do not change LAW 3 and do not add a producer tag in this slice. Make the executable court and production refusal cover readable-source Unreachable only. If authenticated producer provenance is later required, it needs a separately typed outcome/proof and separately scoped authority.
